read: Cue-induced flips by polarity, pooled over the four cues: a TRUE finding is suppressed (yes -> no) at rate 0.0417 (4/96), while an ABSENT finding is hallucinated (no -> yes) at rate 0.1618 (11/68) (paired McNemar pos-only=1 neg-only=9, p=0.021484). A dominant yes->no rate means the cues work mainly by erasing real signal (missed findings); a dominant no->yes rate means they inject spurious signal (false alarms). Symmetry means the cue destabilises the read in both directions equally.
